rationale: Jake is deeply focused on B2A infrastructure and the emerging category of autonomous AI systems—domains where Sharon's company TheAgentic.Ai is actively building production-ready agent infrastructure for biotech, healthtech, and fintech. Jake's conviction that infrastructure and tooling for autonomous AI systems will create billions in value aligns directly with Sharon's work, and his founder background at Derive Labs combined with her technical expertise in AI agent infrastructure represents a natural complement for exploring ideas at the intersection of founder perspective and implementation.
intro_message: Jake Fitzgerald, meet Sharon—you're both focused on the infrastructure and tooling layer for autonomous AI systems, with Jake's founder insights on the B2A category and Sharon's hands-on work building production-ready agent infrastructure.
